message.content: Starting triage on the reported pole failure — shrinking to the minimal case.
Shrink isolated a compact failing case — now verifying it replays deterministically.
Replay is stable — inspecting the violation point and its lead-up.
Ledger: open – noise-induced mis-estimation vs large-dt instability causes pole fall; ruled out – none yet. Checking initial state.
Early state looks clean — tracing the steps right before the fall.
The pole is accelerating away just before the limit — checking earlier steps for the divergence onset.
I see a rapid swing building from the start — confirming the early trend before testing the fix.
My hypothesis is noisy feedback combined with a coarse step destabilizes the pole — testing a clean-sensor counterfactual.
Clean sensors prevent the failure — finalizing the report.
